description: Deeper in the forest. Vidura's final days. His dharma-incarnate essence merges with Yudhishthira through yogic union. Ashramvasika Parva — Vidura's Passing. Mystical, liminal.

vn_backdrop_notes.lighting: Dim, filtered green light through dense canopy.
vn_backdrop_notes.note: Vidura's dharma-incarnate trait resolves here — his essence returns to the cosmic order.
